pull.title: Enable strict account lookup behind a default-off flag
pull.body: Keep legacy callers compatible while the flag is off. When enabled, migrate the adapter response without breaking consumers.
pull.author: fixture-author

files.patch: The strict flag defaults to true and lookup now throws on a miss.
The projected key changes from userId to id.

surroundingContext.src/legacy-caller.js: const account = lookup(id); if (!account) return fallbackAccount;
surroundingContext.tests/lookup.test.js: Tests only strictLookup=true and a populated cache.

expectedRisks: The default-off path is accidentally enabled because strict defaults to true.
The unchanged legacy caller no longer receives null for a missing account.
The adapter and unchanged consumer disagree on id versus userId.

nodes.body: The default-off flag falls back to true, enabling strict behavior for callers that do not pass the flag.
